objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use can and cannot to state one ability and ask for or give permission in a short everyday exchange.
target_patterns: Yes, you can. / No, you cannot.

talk.scenario: You are at a community centre. Ask a partner for permission to use an item and answer one permission question.

check.prompt: Choose the suitable answer to Can I sit here?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: state one ability, ask permission to do one everyday action, and answer one permission question.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use should and should not to give one everyday suggestion and ask for simple advice.
target_patterns: Yes, you should. / No, you should not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ should ಮತ್ತು should not ಬಳಸಿ ಸರಳ ಸಲಹೆ ಕೊಡುವುದು ಮತ್ತು Should I…? ಎಂದು ಕೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. should ನಂತರ ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

talk.scenario: A colleague looks tired after work. Suggest one healthy action and ask one Should I…? question.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Should I wait?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: give one should suggestion, ask one Should I…? question, and answer it.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use do and does to ask and answer simple present questions about everyday habits.
target_patterns: Yes, I do. / No, I do not.
Yes, she does. / No, he does not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ do ಮತ್ತು does ಬಳಸಿ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. you ಜೊತೆ Do; he/she ಜೊತೆ Does.

talk.scenario: You meet a neighbour. Ask about one daily habit and answer one Do you…? question.
fallback_turns: Do you drink tea in the morning?

check.prompt: Choose the correct question about a colleague.
Choose a suitable short reply to Do you cook at home?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: ask one Do you…? question, one Does he/she…? question, and give one short do/does answer.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use am/is/are + -ing to say what someone is doing now and ask one present-continuous question.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು am/is/are + -ing ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದು ಮತ್ತು Are you…? ಎಂದು ಕೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ.

talk.scenario: You are in a busy office. Say what you are doing now and ask a colleague what they are doing.
fallback_turns: I am waiting for a call.

options: She is talking to a customer.
She talks to a customer nowing.
She is talk to a customer.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Are you leaving?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say what you are doing now, ask one Are you…-ing? question, and answer it.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use did to ask and answer simple past questions about yesterday’s actions.
target_patterns: Yes, I did. / No, I did not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿನ್ನೆಯ ಕೆಲಸದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ Did you…? ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿ, did / did not ಎಂದು ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ, ಒಂದು ಭೂತಕಾಲದ ವಾಕ್ಯ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. did ನಂತರ ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ.

talk.scenario: A friend asks about yesterday. Talk about one past action and ask one Did you…? question.
fallback_turns: Did you go to the market?

check.prompt: Choose the correct statement about yesterday.
options: I did called my sister yesterday.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Did you rest?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: ask one Did you…? question, give a short did answer, and state one past action.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use was/were + -ing to say what was happening at a time in the past.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಒಂದು ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು was/were + -ing ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. I/he/she ಜೊತೆ was; you/we/they ಜೊತೆ were.

talk.scenario: A power cut happened at 8 p.m. Say what you were doing then and ask a partner what they were doing.

check.prompt: Choose the sentence about a past moment.
options: She was waiting at the bus stop.
She were waiting at the bus stop.
She was wait at the bus stop.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Were you sleeping?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say what you were doing at a past time, ask one Were you…-ing? question, and answer it.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use have/has + past participle to talk about life experience and recent finished actions with a present result.
target_patterns: Yes, I have. / No, I have not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಭವ ಅಥವಾ ಈಗಲೂ ಸಂಬಂಧವಿರುವ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು have/has + past participle ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. I/you/we/they ಜೊತೆ have; he/she ಜೊತೆ has.

talk.scenario: You are talking about travel and work experience. Share one experience and ask Have you ever…?

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Have you eaten?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: state one I have… experience, ask Have you…?, and give a short have/have not answer.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use have been / has been + -ing to say an action started in the past and is still continuing.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದೆ ಶುರುವಾಗಿ ಈಗಲೂ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು have been / has been + -ing ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಿ, How long…? ಎಂದು ಕೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. for = ಅವಧಿ; since = ಆರಂಭದ ಸಮಯ.

talk.scenario: A trainer asks how long you have been practising English. Answer with have been + -ing and ask one How long…? question.
fallback_turns: I have been practising for two weeks.
How long have you been waiting?
She has been working since morning.

options: I have been studying all morning.
I has been studying all morning.
How long have you been living here?
How long you have been live here?
How long has you been living here?
I have been waiting since 9 a.m.
I have been waiting since two hours.
I have been waiting from I arrived only.

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say how long you have been doing one activity, ask How long have you been…?, and answer.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use had + past participle to say one action was already finished before another past time.
target_patterns: Yes, I had. / No, I had not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೊದಲೇ ಮುಗಿದ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು had + past participle ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ.

talk.scenario: You arrived at a meeting late. Explain what you had already done before you arrived.
fallback_turns: I had sent the file before lunch.

check.prompt: Choose the sentence about an earlier past action.
options: She had left before I arrived.
She had leave before I arrived.
She has left before I arrived yesterday only.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Had you eaten?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say one thing you had already done before another past time, ask Had you…?, and answer.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use will to make one future plan or promise and ask a simple Will you…? request.
target_patterns: Yes, I will. / No, I will not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಳೆಯ ಯೋಜನೆ ಅಥವಾ ವಾಗ್ದಾನವನ್ನು I will + ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಿ, Will you…? ಎಂದು ವಿನಂತಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ.

talk.scenario: You are planning tomorrow with a classmate. Make one promise with will and ask one Will you…? request.
fallback_turns: I will join the class tomorrow.

options: I will to call you tonight.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Will you help?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: make one I will… plan, ask Will you…?, and answer it.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can recognise gonna and wanna in informal speech and reply with a clear going to or want to sentence.
target_patterns: I am going to + base verb.
What are you going to + base verb?
I do not want to + base verb.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತಿನ gonna/wanna ಅನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ going to ಮತ್ತು want to ಎಂದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ.

talk.scenario: A friend uses informal speech: I’m gonna rest. Reply in clear English with going to or want to.
fallback_turns: I am going to practise tonight.
What are you going to do now?

options: I am going to start now.
I gonna start now in this class.

check.prompt: Choose the question about a plan.
options: What are you going to cook?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say one going-to plan, one want-to wish, and ask What are you going to…?

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use would like and Would you…? to make polite offers, requests and preferences.
target_patterns: I would like + noun / to + base verb.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿನಯದಿಂದ ಇಷ್ಟ, ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿನಂತಿಯನ್ನು I would like ಮತ್ತು Would you…? ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ.

talk.scenario: You are ordering tea with a colleague. Make one polite preference and one Would you like…? offer.
fallback_turns: Would you pass the sugar, please?

options: I would like a window seat.
I would liking a window seat.
I would like to a window seat.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Would you like tea?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say I would like…, offer Would you like…?, and make one Would you…, please? request.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use may for polite permission and for a careful possibility.
target_patterns: Yes, you may. / No, you may not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿನಯದ ಅನುಮತಿಗೆ May I…? ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಗೆ may + ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ಬಳಸುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ.

talk.scenario: You are in a quiet office. Ask polite permission with May I…? and say one possible plan with It may…

options: May I to open the window?
She may to come after lunch.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to May I start?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: ask May I…?, answer it, and state one It may… possibility.

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use a simple if clause to talk about a real everyday condition and its result.
target_patterns: If I + present, I will + base verb.
If it rains, we will + base verb.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಜವಾದ ಷರತ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವನ್ನು If + ವರ್ತಮಾನ, will + ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. if ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ will ಬೇಡ.

talk.scenario: You are planning a weekend outing. Use one if sentence about weather or time and ask What will you do if…?
fallback_turns: If it rains, we will stay inside.
If I finish early, I will call you.
What will you do if the bus is late?

options: If I have time, I will join.
If I will have time, I will join.
If I have time, I joining.
What will you do if she is busy?
What will you do if she will be busy?
What you do if she is busy?
If the shop is closed, we will wait.
If the shop is closed, we wait will.
If the shop closed, we will waiting.

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say one If…, I will… sentence and ask What will you do if…?

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use must and must not for strong everyday rules and obligations.
target_patterns: Yes, you must. / No, you must not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ನಿಯಮಕ್ಕೆ must ಮತ್ತು ನಿಷೇಧಕ್ಕೆ must not ಬಳಸುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. must ನಂತರ ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ.

talk.scenario: You are explaining a workplace or classroom rule. State one must obligation and one must not prohibition.

options: You must to show your ticket.
You must not to park here.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Must I wait?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: give one must rule, one must not rule, and ask Must I…?

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use should have + past participle to talk about a better past choice without blaming harshly.
target_patterns: You should not have + past participle.
Yes, you should have. / No, you should not have.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು should have + past participle ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. ದೂಷಣೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಧಾನ ಸಲಹೆ.

talk.scenario: A meeting started without the notes. Talk about one better past action with should have.

options: I should have checked the time.
I should have check the time.
I should had checked the time.
You should not have waited so long.
You should not have wait so long.
You should not had waited so long.

check.prompt: Choose a suitable short reply to Should I have asked?

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say I should have…, give one You should have…, and ask Should I have…?

objective: By the end of this lesson, the learner can use used to + base verb to talk about a past habit that is not true now.
target_patterns: I did not use to + base verb.
Did you use to + base verb?
Yes, I did. / No, I did not.
kannada_summary: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇದ್ದ ಆದರೆ ಈಗ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು used to + ಮೂಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ: Did you use to…?

talk.scenario: You are talking about school days versus now. Share one old habit with used to and ask Did you use to…?
fallback_turns: I used to walk to school.
Did you use to play cricket?
I do not walk now. I take the bus.

options: I used to drink more tea.
I used to drinking more tea.
I use to drink more tea then.
Did you use to live here?
Did you used to live here?
Did you use to lived here?

check.prompt: Choose the clearer contrast with now.
options: I used to cook every day. Now I cook on Sundays.
I used to cook every day and I still used to.
I used cook every day now.

apply.task: Record a 20–30 second exchange: say one I used to… habit, ask Did you use to…?, and contrast with now.
